verdict.rationale: The front page carries only a reactive notice that high retrieval volumes repeatedly overload individual states' registers and make them temporarily unavailable (handelsregister-docs-13). That is an outage status note, not a published operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout that a founder can read before starting the online flow. The axis applies to an online register and filing portal, but the evidence does not show this capability.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
